correctness.rationale: For each coordinate face, the stabilizer preserves both the face and the excluded-vertex convex hull; simultaneous averaging reduces distance to a positive-definite two-variable quadratic. Every outsider has a unit total fixed-coordinate violation, and explicit single swaps attain both boundary rays, proving equality in the relaxed minimization. The exact rational optimum is \(n/[n(a+b)-(a-b)^2]\). Vertex faces are treated separately and cannot dominate for \(n\ge3\). One discrete increment and one integer concave parabola prove the global formula and boundary cases. The standalone verifier passed 49,100 finite checks, and numerical independent QPs matched 41 instances; infinity is proved analytically, not inferred from tests.
